subject: Exchange: evaluation assets, usage limits, and close timeline
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@atlas-retail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Atlas Retail Procurement <procurement@atlas-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Exchange of evaluation assets and MAP

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our ML and product teams were impressed with the latency profiles you showed. We'd like to move forward with a short mutual action plan so we can validate Redwood on a representative workload.

High level ask: Atlas intends to run a two-week pilot using a mix of synthetic and redacted customer queries. We need to receive:
- a zipped evaluation dataset (no PII),
- a small prompt pack + scoring rubric, and
- a short MAP with milestones and usage constraints (ephemeral access, no retention beyond the pilot).

Procurement is on-copied — their baseline requirements include a standard NDA and a simple MPA for data handling. Can you confirm you can provide the assets and a proposed timeline this week? Also flag any constraints on model caching or KV persistence that could affect our compliance team.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of ML Ops, Atlas Retail

---
Attachments: none listed
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:31:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Exchange of evaluation assets and MAP

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely support a two-week pilot and I've looped in Marissa (solutions) and Karthik (model ops) to scope the artifacts and operational controls.

Quick responses / plan:
1) Assets: we will provision an "ephemeral" bundle containing a redacted dataset (eval_dataset_v1.zip) and a 12-case prompt pack (promptpack_sample.pdf). Those will be delivered under a limited-use agreement (no external sharing, delete after 45 days by default).
2) MAP: attached is our draft MAP (MAP-draft-v2.docx) with milestones: delivery, validation week 1, smoke tests, acceptance checkpoint.
3) Controls: by default we do not persist raw customer inputs beyond the inference session; KV cache is session-scoped for the pilot and can be disabled. Karthik will enumerate exact retention toggles.

Next steps:
- We can provision the bundle to a secure S3/share within 24 hours after a quick MPA signature.
- Can we aim for kickoff on Mon Jul 26? That gives your team a couple of days to sign and onboard.

I'm attaching the MAP draft and a short checklist. If procurement needs a redline, send the copy to me and we'll prioritize.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Tel: +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Logan — that sounds promising. Procurement asked for two small edits on the MAP:
- explicit clause: Redwood will not retain raw input after inference beyond the stated session unless Atlas opts in;
- a 45-day deletion confirmation for any derived artifacts unless we request otherwise.

Procurement also wants the contact who will sign the MPA (they prefer a legal/ops sig). Please copy procurement@atlas-retail.com when you send the final package for signature.

We can target kickoff on Mon Jul 26 — but first we need the asset bundle and a short runbook so our infra team can mount the data in our staging VPC. Can you provide the runbook and a Drive link with the files?

Elena

Hi Elena — looping in the delivery details below and appending the usage constraints requested by procurement.

What we will deliver (by Thu Jul 22, EOD):
- Drive link (secure, access-limited) with: eval_dataset_v1.zip (redacted CSV), promptpack_sample.pdf, scoring rubrics, and the MAP-draft-v2.docx (updated).
- A short runbook (runbook.md) describing mount steps for a staging VPC, expected file layout, and the minimal IAM policy.

Usage constraints we're adding to the MAP:
- Non-disclosure: the assets are provided for Atlas's internal evaluation only; no external redistribution.
- Retention: Atlas will not retain raw inputs or model logs beyond the pilot; derived aggregate metrics are permitted. Redwood will run a deletion job at +45 days unless Atlas requests extension.
- Ephemeral sandbox: any KV cache will be disabled by default; caching can be explicitly enabled for throughput trials but must be documented in the runbook.
- Auditability: we will provide a one-time audit report of the pilot timestamps and deletion confirmation on request.

Attachments (attached to this message): eval_dataset_v1.zip (stub), promptpack_sample.pdf (stub), MAP-draft-v2.docx (redline incorporated).

If procurement is happy with the updated MAP, please reply-all with a sign-off and we'll send the DocuSign MPA. Otherwise, list the redlines and we'll update.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
